newsitem.title: USA: US replacement lead battery shipments dip in Nov.
newsitem.headline: US replacement lead battery shipments dip in Nov.

text.p: Shipments of replacement lead acid batteries in November fell 8.08 percent to 6,660,726 units from October's level, and were off 2.98 percent from November 1995's rate, the Battery Council International reported.
In January through November 1996, replacement battery shipments totaled 70,458,564 units, up 1.44 percent on the same period in 1995.
In the 12 months ending November 1996, shipments totaled 78,053,231 units, up 1.64 percent on the previous period.
